in_marathi.name: Brindha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Brindha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Brindha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Brind' meaning lotus. In Hindu mythology, Brindha is the name of a celestial nymph, who is believed to have emerged from the lotus flower. She is also known as Brinda or Brindavani, and is associated with Lord Krishna and the Radha-Krishna relationship.
